summary: [Exhibitor Categories] Saving a product limit deletes products with no warning or confirmation

ai.s: Adds a warning and confirmation before saving an exhibitor category product limit, which today silently deletes every product above the limit.
ai.pr: Lowering a category's active-products limit immediately and irreversibly deleted excess products with no warning, confirmation or report; in IMP-321 about 2,200 products were purged.
ai.wy: Organisers lose exhibitor data without knowing; EP-57473 fixed the scope but not the silent interaction.
ai.oc: Saving a lower limit is to warn, require confirmation and report what will be removed.

summary: Migrate portal-ui to the normalized Alert from expo-react-components

ai.s: Migrates portal-ui from its custom Alert to the normalised Alert in expo-react-components and deletes the local component.
ai.pr: portal-ui's Alert reimplemented variants, colours, icons and layout in inline sx across 34 importing files.
ai.wy: Follow-on from EP-56075, which moved the Alert look into the shared theme.
ai.oc: All usages are to switch to the shared Alert or MUI Alert with theme overrides, and components/UI/Alert is to be removed.

summary: Migrate admin-ui to the normalized Alert from expo-react-components

ai.s: Migrates admin-ui from its custom Alert to the normalised Alert in expo-react-components and deletes the local component.
ai.pr: admin-ui carried a near-copy of portal-ui's custom Alert with the same inline-styled variants, icons and layout overrides.
ai.wy: Follow-on from EP-56075 to use one shared Alert across apps.
ai.oc: All admin-ui usages are to move to the shared Alert and src/components/UI/Alert is to be removed.

ai.s: Adds an academic title field for event participants, shown with names across registration, profiles, sessions, search, badges, mobile and exports.
ai.pr: Participants had no academic title field, so titles could not be captured or displayed with names.
ai.wy: Needed for DACH-market events; detail is in a linked Confluence page.
ai.oc: Cross-team scope is outlined, with a Visitor team estimate of BE 15, FE 5–7 and QA 7–9 days.

summary: Mobile: display Academic Title next to participant names on agenda session cards, speaker list and attendee profile cards, without truncating the name

ai.s: The mobile app shows a participant's academic title before their name on agenda cards, speaker lists and attendee profiles, without truncating the name.
ai.pr: The app had no academic title, so DLG and FBM used workarounds and DACH participants saw names wrong for their market.
ai.wy: Correct naming for DACH clients such as DLG and FBM.
ai.oc: The title is to render in the salutation position, names are to wrap or shrink but never clip, and older app versions show the plain name.

summary: Mobile app: allow opted-out users to favourite exhibitors, visitors and products

ai.s: Opted-out users can now favourite and unfavourite exhibitors, visitors and products in the mobile app, privately, as they already could on web.
ai.pr: The app did not render the favourite option for opted-out users, so the same user got different behaviour on web and mobile.
ai.wy: Completes EP-53978 across platforms; requested by DLG.
ai.oc: The favourite affordance shows for opted-out users on all three surfaces, stored privately so the other party is never identified; done.

ai.s: Builds the Accounts module operations the Exhibitor module needs for owner accounts, so account data is no longer written by the Exhibitor module.
ai.pr: The Exhibitor module called stubs that only wrote a log line, so two admin endpoints failed.
ai.wy: Module ownership in the new architecture: the Accounts module must own account data.
ai.oc: Create owner account, set logo and login, sync company name and deactivate on delete are to be implemented per the attached spec.

ai.s: Adds multi-tier gating for the new registration UI in global and event Module Management (detail is in a linked Confluence page only).

summary: Root error boundary sits above the locale layout: every crash ends in HierarchyRequestError and a blank page

ai.s: Fixes the root error boundary placement so a crash shows an error page instead of a HierarchyRequestError loop and a blank page.
ai.pr: The only app-wide error boundary sat above the locale root layout, so any error stripped the html element, failed to append the fallback and looped.
ai.wy: Observability and reliability: every crash ended in a blank page with misleading error reports.
ai.oc: A correctly placed boundary (e.g. global-error) is to render a fallback without destroying the document; in progress.

summary: Floorplan: stop treating an empty stand/hall payload as a failed request

ai.s: Stops the admin floorplan treating a hall with no stands as a failed request, ending an ongoing unhandled Sentry error.
ai.pr: An empty hall returned data: [] and the shape guard rejected arrays, raising "Failed to fetch stand list" (51 events, 16 users).
ai.wy: Sentry noise and false errors on the admin exhibitor page.
ai.oc: Empty payloads are handled as valid, removing the unhandled rejection; ready for release.

summary: Integrations catalog: move SAML 2.0 settings to a dedicated integration page (urgent – DLG)

ai.s: SAML 2.0 settings now have their own page in the Integrations catalog instead of the shared legacy settings page.
ai.pr: SAML still pointed to /admin/general/settings while hub integrations had dedicated pages.
ai.oc: A page at /admin/integrations/saml on the hub template reuses existing storage with no data migration, and the catalog entry points to it; done.

summary: Show the backend's error message when auth type changes mid-login, instead of a hardcoded one

ai.s: Shows the backend's "sign-in settings have changed" message when the auth type changes mid-login, instead of a hardcoded invalid-login text.
ai.pr: If an admin switched between OTP and password while a user was logging in, the screen showed its own static error rather than the specific backend message.
ai.wy: Users were told their credentials were wrong when the real cause was a settings change.
ai.oc: For errorCode 1002 the app is to display the backend error text; other cases stay unchanged.

summary: [Reg-OT][BE][Payments][Part 2.1][Split1] Purchasing: bring invoice and cumulative discounts back, and close the Part 2 review items

ai.s: The sprint-sized split of EP-57315, bringing invoice payment and cumulative discounts back to new Registration purchasing.
ai.pr: Not clearly specified beyond the ticket title; all context lives on parent story EP-57315.
ai.oc: Not clearly specified beyond the ticket title and the parent story.

summary: Mobile app: hide Meet and Message when Meetings / Messages are turned off in Module Management — iOS + Android

ai.s: Makes the iOS and Android apps hide Meet and Message when Meetings or Messages are turned off in Module Management.
ai.pr: The apps ignored Module Management toggles, so attendees still saw Meet and Message after an organiser disabled them.
ai.wy: A repeated family of live-event bugs (EP-40944, EP-57200, EP-57216, EP-57664) and one predictable rule for organisers.
ai.oc: Module Management is to have the same effect as the Permission Matrix, removing the actions everywhere in the app.

summary: Edit profile: show values under moderation and highlight fields awaiting organiser approval (speakers, events with pre-moderation)

ai.s: Speakers see their pending values and a notice when profile changes await organiser approval, instead of thinking their data was not saved.
ai.pr: With pre-moderation on, speaker profile changes went to approval silently, which looked like a failed save (EP-56625).
ai.wy: Make moderation status explicit for speakers and organisers.
ai.oc: Edit profile is to show submitted values, highlight moderated fields and show a banner; the organiser's visitor card highlights them too.

summary: [portalUI] Observability on next14: Sentry error capture and structured CloudWatch logs

ai.s: Restores observability in portal-ui on next14 with Sentry error capture and structured CloudWatch logs.
ai.pr: Sentry had been removed, the browser had no error handlers, 54 console.error calls went nowhere and process crashes wrote nothing.
ai.wy: Production failures were almost invisible to the team.
ai.oc: Sentry is to be reinstated with source maps, global handlers added and logs structured so they can be alerted on.
